prerequisites: Knowledge of linear algebra (matrices, vectors, and eigenvalues)
Familiarity with programming in MATLAB, C/C++ or Python

learning_outcomes.text: Select the most appropriate hardware to solve a given perception problem.
Assess the suitability of different processing techniques to solve a given problem.
Build a system capable of identifying and describing objects of interest present in the scene.
Design a system capable of reconstructing the 3D geometry of the scene.
Evaluate the adequacy of a system to solve a given perception problem.

syllabus_topics: Extraction and description of characteristic points
assessment_rules: To pass the course in the ordinary call, a minimum score of 5 out of 10 in the theoretical exam (E1) and 4 out of 10 in the course project (T1) is mandatory. If these minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as: Note = 0.7 · E1 + 0.3 · T1. Otherwise, the grade will be the minimum between the calculated note and 4.0. The same elements and criteria apply for extraordinary calls.
